runtimeUnsupported.title: Skills are not available in this browser yet
runtimeUnsupported.description: The skill catalog, authoring, installation, and editing currently require Void Desktop. The browser will not send unsupported requests.

runtimeReadOnly: This runtime can only read skills. Authoring, installation, editing, and deletion are disabled.

authoring.subtitleCreate: Describe the need, supply material, or fill the form manually. Every route produces the same validated skill definition.
authoring.subtitleEdit: The display name can change while the runtime ID and installation scope stay stable.
authoring.runtimeIdAuto: Void creates an immutable runtime ID on save. You can still rename the display name later.

describe.label: What should this skill help with?
describe.placeholder: For example: analyze financial reports, verify key metrics, and return risks and next steps.

material.label: Paste an existing prompt, workflow, or guide
material.placeholder: Void will organize roles, steps, constraints, and delivery requirements from the material.

authoring.localOrganizeHint: Draft organization runs locally and never expands the current session's tools or write permissions.
authoring.draftPrepared: The skill draft is ready for review and saving.
authoring.prepareFirst: Organize the description or material before saving.
authoring.scenarioHint: The skill appears only in selected scenarios. This setting can only narrow access.
authoring.configurationHint: Runtime identity stays separate from presentation
authoring.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe when this skill should be used
authoring.instructionsPlaceholder: Define steps, constraints, inputs, and output requirements
authoring.permissionInherited: Permissions inherit the intersection of the scenario, active Agent, and user policy. A skill cannot grant permissions.
authoring.remoteProjectUnsupported: Remote workspaces do not support project skill authoring yet.
authoring.runtimeUnsupported: This runtime does not support skill authoring.

diagnostics.source_text_required: Describe the need or provide material.
diagnostics.suggested_prompt_required: Enter at least one suggested prompt.
diagnostics.too_many_suggested_prompts: Use no more than 3 suggested prompts.

errors.unsupported_transport: This runtime does not support skill authoring.
errors.unsupported_remote_project: Remote workspaces do not support project skill authoring yet.
errors.not_found: This skill could not be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.not_authorable: This skill was not authored by Void and cannot be edited in place. You can still inspect or re-import it.
errors.revision_conflict: The skill changed after it was opened. Reload it before saving.
errors.validation_failed: The skill did not pass validation. Check required fields and length limits.
errors.read_failed: The skill file could not be read. Check that it exists and that access is allowed.
errors.write_failed: The skill file could not be saved. The existing version was not overwritten.
errors.rollback_failed: Saving failed and automatic recovery was incomplete. Use the recovery path in the logs.

template.describeRole: Use this skill when the task matches "__NAME__".
template.describeRule1: 1. Confirm the goal, inputs, and expected output first.
template.describeRule2: 2. Follow the described workflow and identify missing information.
template.describeRule3: 3. Return only completed results and never claim an operation ran when it did not.
template.materialRole: Use the "__NAME__" skill and treat the supplied material as the working basis.
template.materialRule1: 1. Preserve roles, order, constraints, and output requirements from the material.
template.materialRule2: 2. Surface conflicts or gaps before proposing the smallest viable approach.
template.materialRule3: 3. Never expand tools, permissions, or write scope beyond the active session.
template.suggestedPrompt2: Check my material and tell me the next steps.
template.suggestedPrompt3: Return a directly usable result in the required format.
